prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 84.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 77.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 32.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder), altering finish layouts (finish, layout), and adding new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance.
Sign-in redesigns (sign_in, redesign) underperformed consistently, producing zero winning tests and multiple losses.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and home wait-info updates (home, wait_info) proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Adoption new screens (adoption, new_screen) generated multiple winning tests, though overall performance remained mixed with several losses.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes, redesigns, layout shifts, and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the magnitude of positive gains achieved by winning tests.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: sign_in_returning_user_pet_restore_hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging in with their existing account automatically restores all previously saved pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, showing sign-in account restoration reassurance is critical.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account automatically restores all your saved pets and desktop preferences.

candidates.title: adoption_care_instructions_new_screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before adoption confirmation detailing essential daily pet care routines and desktop interaction basics.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 77.2% and finish conversion drops to 64.8%, partly because users lack clear expectations about companion care.

new_care_instructions.headline: How to Care for Your Pet
new_care_instructions.body: Learn the basics of feeding, playing, and managing your companion on your desktop.

components.text: Click to play, drag to reposition, right-click for settings menu.

candidates.title: waiting_pet_rendering_checklist_wait_info
candidates.change: Provide status updates on screen resolution checks and rendering progress on the waiting screen while the pet is loaded.
candidates.why: Home step has a high mean duration of 2336s and 3 support emails reported that the pet did not show up on the desktop.

waiting.body: Preparing your desktop pet... Checking screen resolution and asset rendering.

candidates.title: upload_photos_validation_tips_new_screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated photo verification screen before pet generation to ensure photo lighting and angle yield good 3D pet rendering.
candidates.why: Support mail logged 3 reports of custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.

new_photo_validation.headline: Photo Quality Check
new_photo_validation.body: Ensure clear lighting and front-facing photos for optimal 3D pet rendering.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_toggle_guide_hint
candidates.change: Add a quick hint on the home intro screen detailing hotkeys to show, hide, and reposition the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.

home_intro.hint: Press Ctrl+Shift+P to instantly show or hide your pet on your desktop.

candidates.title: story_companion_selection_copy
candidates.change: Update the story screen body copy to emphasize the choice between pre-made animated companions and custom photo-based pets.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating initial hesitation about available path options.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose from a gallery of ready-to-play pets or generate a custom pet from your own photos.

candidates.title: pick_friend_split_preview_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout separating personality traits on one side from live animated previews on the other.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is 77.2% with a median time of 89s as users take long to evaluate pet choices.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Friend
pick_friend.body: Select a companion to see their live animations and unique personalities.

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_launch_status_wait_info
candidates.change: Display explicit instructions on the waiting screen on how to check the system tray icon if the pet does not immediately appear on desktop.
candidates.why: Support mail highlighted 3 bug reports about pets failing to appear on desktop upon app launch.

waiting.hint: If your pet does not appear on screen in 30 seconds, check your system tray menu to enable overlay mode.

candidates.title: sign_in_account_data_safety_copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body text to affirm that signing in secures existing pet data and cloud saves.
candidates.why: 8 emails reported missing or reset pets after signing in, indicating sign-in safety messaging needs higher prominence.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pets
sign_in.body: Logging into your account securely backs up your companion data and restores previously adopted pets.

candidates.title: home_intro_pet_interaction_new_flow
candidates.change: Insert a brief interactive demonstration step into the home intro flow requiring users to try dragging and right-clicking their pet.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and multiple users complain in support of not knowing how to control or hide their pet.

new_interaction_demo.headline: Quick Desktop Practice
new_interaction_demo.body: Try moving your pet and opening the quick menu to complete onboarding.
